1.44 Explain a Cloud Sync indicator that never settles

Symptom. Sync keeps showing activity, and View opens an empty list.

Method. Decode asset_sync_status_ui for your keep-locally configuration with the status-code table. In the reference library, 3 photos remained. They were imported on an iPad that never finished uploading: no server renditions, no thumbnail, and a refusal decided from the photo’s own record.

Fix. Open Lightroom on the importing device while it’s online. Don’t delete the records first, because the deletion syncs to that device too.
